title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing AI Agent Builder em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Confira esta oportunidade para Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Role Description

The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: P2P Business Development Manager
description:

About Us:

• Global Scale: We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets.

• Industry Leader: Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, supporting a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets.

• Our Team: Backed by thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally.

• Our Culture: We operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments.


About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented P2P Merchant Operations Manager to join our dynamic operations team. In this role, you will be a key driver of our P2P ecosystem, focusing on nurturing relationships with existing platform merchants, expanding our network by onboarding new high-quality merchant clients, and maintaining platform integrity through careful application reviews and market research. If you are a proactive team player with a deep understanding of the crypto P2P landscape and the resilience to thrive under pressure, we'd love to have you on board.

2. Develop and expand new merchant clients.

3. Review and approve merchant applications.

4. Conduct market research.

5. Assist with other related operational tasks.

1. Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 2 years of relevant P2P work experience in the cryptocurrency industry.

2. Familiar with internet platform resource management processes and possess basic data analysis skills.

3. Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.

4. Detail-oriented, responsible, and able to work well under pressure.

  • 3+ years of professional development experience with Python, GoLang, Rust or equivalent languages. Expertise in Rust and Python is highly valued.
  • 3+ years of experience with cloud infrastructure, specifically AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

  • 5+ years of experience working with Linux/Unix environments.

  • Experience with text codec, encoding & web protocols
  • Bash, Scala, C, or Hive development experience
  • Experience with full stack development

  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.

  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Técnico SAP I em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/AI tools) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Risk Management Officer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Chiniese-Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator（Mandarin required））
description:

About the Role: We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Brazilian Portuguese Interpreter & Project Coordinator to join our international team. This role serves as the critical bridge between our Chinese headquarters and our local operations in Brazil. It is a unique opportunity not only to utilize your language skills but also to grow into a project management or regional operations role.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Mandarin Interpretation & Translation: Provide high-quality consecutive interpretation (Mandarin ↔ Brazilian Portuguese) for board meetings, business negotiations, and technical site visits.

Qualifications (Mandarin is Essential):

  • Language Proficiency (Mandatory): Native or professional-level fluency in Mandarin Chinese (HSK 4 or equivalent) and Brazilian Portuguese. (English is a plus)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.
  • Experience: Proven experience in Chinese-Portuguese interpretation/translation. Candidates who have studied or worked in China are highly preferred.
  • Communication: Exceptional cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to convey complex technical concepts between Chinese and Brazilian teams.
  • Mindset: Strong sense of responsibility and willingness to work on-site (Expat/Stationed) with the Chinese team.

What We Offer (Benefits & Welfare):

  • Home Leave: 1-2 times per year (Total 28 days), with round-trip international airfare fully covered by the company.

  • Accommodation: Corporate housing provided.

Career Growth: This is a developmental role with a clear career path. Top performers will have the opportunity to be promoted to core positions in Project Management or Regional Operations .

title: Lead Data Engineering (Remoto)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Data Engineering (Remoto) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa do setor de georastreamento na busca por um(a) Data Engineering Team Lead para liderar iniciativas estratégicas de dados e impulsionar a evolução da sua plataforma. Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil player-coach , capaz de equilibrar uma atuação técnica hands-on com a liderança de equipe, sendo responsável por guiar o time na construção de uma infraestrutura de dados moderna, escalável e orientada ao negócio. É essencial possuir inglês avançado ou fluente para conversação , já que a posição envolve interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais. A contratação é no modelo CLT , com atuação 100% remota .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Atuação Estratégica e Técnica

  • Atuar como engenheiro(a) sênior, participando diretamente do desenvolvimento (design, codificação e entrega de features).
  • Liderar o desenho e evolução da arquitetura de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, confiabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com tecnologias modernas como Snowflake, Databricks e serviços em cloud (AWS/Azure).
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver o time, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alta performance.
  • Incentivar o crescimento técnico e de carreira dos engenheiros.
  • Atuar em conjunto com Product Managers na descoberta e definição de soluções, garantindo alinhamento com necessidades do negócio.
  • Definir e garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, engenharia e metodologias ágeis.
  • Gerenciar e reduzir dívida técnica da plataforma.
  • Liderar iniciativas de análise, planejamento e execução de projetos de dados.
  • Garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos.


Responsabilidades do Dia a Dia:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (Airbyte, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory).
  • Construir e manter infraestrutura de dados robusta e escalável.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de dados, produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Gerenciar infraestrutura com práticas modernas (Terraform, Ansible, Azure Application Insights).
  • Garantir governança, qualidade e confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Atuar na operação de ambientes produtivos, incluindo suporte a incidentes críticos.
  • Promover inovação contínua e adoção de novas tecnologias, incluindo uso de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados, ETL e ambientes produtivos.
  • Experiência com Airbyte, Fivetran, Snowflake, Databricks e Azure Data Factory.
  • Forte domínio de SQL e modelagem de dados (incluindo grandes volumes).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI e Sigma.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Programação em Python (diferencial: Scala).
  • Experiência com Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em data lakes, bancos relacionais, NoSQL e OLAP.
  • Boa comunicação e visão orientada a produto.
  • Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com pipelines de AI/ML e serviços como AWS SageMaker ou Azure Synapse.
  • Vivência com governança de dados e qualidade.
  • Background em sistemas distribuídos, APIs ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.


Formação e Experiência

  • Mais de 6 anos de experiência em Data Engineering (hands-on).
  • Mais de 3 anos liderando times ou iniciativas de dados.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.

title: GTM Builder
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para GTM Builder em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

GTM builder

You are an AI-native builder. You don’t just use AI tools; you build agents, copilots, and autonomous systems. You understand how modern LLMs actually work: tool use, reasoning loops, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration. You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...

You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

You Will:

• Design and deploy autonomous AI agents that can research, reason, and execute real business workflows

• Build agentic systems using modern LLM capabilities including tool use, function calling, structured outputs, and multi-step reasoning

• Create internal AI copilots used daily by marketing, sales and operations

• Implement retrieval systems (RAG) using embeddings and vector databases to give agents context and memory

• Build AI workflows that can enrich accounts, qualify leads, generate insights, and automate execution

• Integrate AI agents deeply into our stack: HubSpot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems

• Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort

• Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence

• Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available

• Continuously improve agents to make them faster, smarter, cheaper, and more reliable

• Build reusable internal frameworks, tools, and agent architectures

• Own systems end-to-end — from idea to production

You Have:

• Strong software engineering ability and the ability to ship working systems quickly

• Hands-on experience building with modern LLMs and AI tools (OpenAI, Anthropic, open models, or similar)

• Experience building AI agents, copilots, or automated workflows

• Strong prompt engineering skills and understanding of structured prompting and reliability

• Experience integrating APIs, webhooks, and external systems

• Ability to work with structured and unstructured data

• Experience with automation tools like N8N, Make, Zapier, or similar

• Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment systems, and data pipelines

• Strong builder mindset — you learn fast, experiment fast, and ship fast

• High agency — you figure things out without needing step-by-step instructions

• Curiosity and obsession with new AI capabilities

• Bonus: Experience with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval systems

• Bonus: Experience building multi-step agent workflows

• Bonus: You actively build AI projects outside of work

• Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Professor de francês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de francês em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to planning, daily stand-ups, and continuous collaboration to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.



Competencies/Requirements:


  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: ENGENHEIRO DE DADOS SÊNIOR | REMOTO
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ENGENHEIRO DE DADOS SÊNIOR | REMOTO em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

LOCALIZA&CO

Estar em constante evolução nos trouxe até aqui. Ao lado de talentos e habilidades múltiplas nos conectamos em busca da nossa motivação: construir o futuro da mobilidade sustentável. É por meio da valorização da individualidade de cada um que impulsionamos o nosso movimento para conquistar resultados extraordinários, desenvolver nossas operações e criar soluções para os nossos clientes.

Somos apaixonados por nossa história, por nossas ideias e pela capacidade de realizá-las. Sabemos que juntos, todos vamos mais longe.

É assim que conectamos a Localiza&Co com o futuro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar pipelines de dados robustas, conectando dados de diversas fontes utilizando principalmente ferramentas do ecossistema AWS;
  • Entender demandas do Negócio e dos diversos Produtos de software e traduzí-las em Produtos de Dados eficientes e escaláveis;
  • Atuar como referência técnica no desenho arquitetural de soluções orientadas a dados (Data Driven) e IA (AI First), articulando entre produto, analytics e ML para definir padrões, boas práticas, SLAs, observabilidade e governança da plataforma;
  • Implementar soluções de enriquecimento de dados escaláveis e eficientes utilizando o DBT para transformar dados brutos em modelos de dados personalizados e insights acionáveis para o negócio;
  • Gerenciar integrações, processos de transformação e automações de tarefas usando conectores de dados, APIs SQL, Python e Rest;
  • Utilizar SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Aplicar Spark para processamento de grandes volumes de dados em tempo real (Kafka e similares) e em batch.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • AWS (Athena, S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda);
  • Proficiência em SQL, DBT, Python e Spark;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de dados como Apache Airflow;
  • Conhecimentos sobre diferentes técnicas de arquitetura e modelagem de dados para fins analíticos (Ex.: Data Mesh, Data Mart, Data Lake, Data Warehouse);
  • Experiência com Modelagem de Dados (relacional e/ou analítico) e processos ETL;
  • Experiência em Desenvolvimento de Software (APIs, Gateways, Micro Serviços e Containers) e CI/CD;
  • Noções sobre boas práticas de engenharia de software (Documentação, testes automatizados, código limpo, monitoramento (Datadog).


Diferenciais:

Possuir Certificações AWS associadas à função de Cloud Data Engineer, sendo elas:

  • Cloud Practitioner;
  • Data Engineer;
  • Solutions Architect;
  • Machine Learning Engineer.


BENEFÍCIOS DESSA POSIÇÃO

  • Participação nos Lucros
  • Carro Corporativo
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Convênio Médico
  • Convênio Odontológico
  • Gympass
  • Previdência Privada
  • Auxílio Home Office
  • Allya
  • Acesso ilimitado a diversos cursos da nossa Universidade Localiza
  • Programas internos de treinamento e desenvolvimento
  • Desconto em compra e aluguel de veículos

Viva a experiência de ser Localiza&Co e venha construir o futuro da mobilidade conosco!

title: Python/Cloud Platform Developer
description:

Python/Cloud Platform Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

  • Desenvolvimento de documentos Padronizado (PDD e SDD);

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Salesforce Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. Technical DNA

  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.

  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.


LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. The company simplifies delivery management by connecting businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizing in-house delivery operations. Through its logistics, financial, and marketing tools, Metrobi empowers local businesses to confidently grow their distribution networks. Metrobi operates with a mission to enhance efficiency and scale for local makers and distributors.


Intro video:


Responsibilities

  • Backlog & Kanban Management:

Own the Kanban board: organize tasks, ensure priorities are clear and understand what is stopping us from maintaining our task flow to hit our deployment goals. Communicate risks, issues, blockers, and quality concerns to the PM and relevant team members.

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

  • Validate Outcomes, Not Just Output:

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Product Management and Business Analysis to define and evaluate product requirements effectively.
  • Excellent Communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with Software Development processes and tools to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast-paced working environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is preferred.
  • Skills like SQL, Git, reading Python code and doing data analysis are very beneficial, but not required


Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Legal Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Legal Writer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

U.S. Immigration Law Firm, Law offices of Jacob J Sapochnick is growing and developing law firm in the USA that specializes in business, employment, investment, and family immigration to the USA. The law firm is known for providing its best to the clients by offering creative and strategic legal solutions. We are looking for the new team member, legal writer, to join our team.


Responsibilities:


Legal Brief & Petition Drafting:

  • Preparing legal briefs , including personal statements, expert opinions, and supporting arguments .
  • Engaging in extensive drafting , developing persuasive and well-structured arguments tailored to each case.

Case Strategy & Implementation:

  • Collaborating with senior legal specialists and U.S. attorneys to understand and execute case strategy effectively.
  • Ensuring that all legal arguments align with case objectives and meet the highest professional standards.

Legal Research & Analysis:

  • Conducting in-depth legal research to identify relevant statutes, judicial decisions, and immigration regulations
  • Staying up to date with evolving immigration laws and policy changes to ensure compliance and accuracy.
  • Be creative in drafting – must have!!!

Document Review

  • Reviewing client-provided documentation , identifying missing materials
  • Ensuring petitions are fully prepared in advance for mid and final attorney reviews, facilitating timely submission.

Attorney Support & Quality Assurance:

  • Assisting attorneys in case preparation, including gathering supporting documents, drafting legal arguments, and compiling evidence .
  • Collaborating with team members to enhance the accuracy, clarity, and persuasiveness of all written materials .


Requirements:


·      Excellent grammar, spelling, and written English composition skills is a must.


·      B.A. Degree in Law or Political Sciences or English studies student or graduate.


·      Previous legal or immigration writing experience preferred.


·      Extraordinary research and creative writing skills in English.


·      High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and excellent proofreading skills.


·      Strong organizational skills; ability to work under pressure, work within competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.


·      Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to quickly learn new applications.


  • Salary depending on experience from $ - $ .



Schedule:

  • 8-hour shift,
  • Monday to Friday
  • Remote work
